_comment: Toy Montgomery County TB CXR set used in the RadHarmony datathon. A folder of PNG chest X-rays plus a small metadata CSV (data/montgomery_index.csv) with one row per image and columns pid / fname / tb. CSV-driven: the raw table already lists every image, so the harmonizer just maps columns. Full dataset source: https://data.lhncbc.nlm.nih.gov/public/Tuberculosis-Chest-X-ray-Datasets/Montgomery-County-CXR-Set/

primary_csv._comment: The metadata CSV that lists every image row.

patient_id._comment: Direct column: pid. One study per patient in this set.

study_id._comment: Same as patient_id; one study per patient.

image_path._comment: The fname column is already a bare filename relative to base_image_dir.

labels._comment: Single binary TB label carried straight from the primary CSV.

separate_csv._comment: Label lives in the primary CSV; no separate file.

view_position._comment: All images are frontal CXRs; no view-position column.

masks._comment: Not exposed in this toy integration.

reports._comment: Not exposed in this toy integration.
